title: Portfolio CMS - Admin Command Center
shortDescription: An enterprise-grade, Electron-powered headless CMS architected for portfolio content orchestration and metadata management.
description: The Portfolio CMS Admin Panel is an advanced desktop command center engineered to decouple presentation from content logic. Designed to bypass the rigid structures of off-the-shelf solutions, this application provides an isolated, secure environment for orchestrating dynamic datasets including project metadata, nested case studies, technical blogs, and interactive skill matrices. Built as a desktop-first application leveraging Electron and Vite, it delivers high performance and OS-level integration while maintaining modern web agility.
myContributions: Architected and single-handedly engineered a complete headless CMS ecosystem bridging a high-speed Vite/React renderer with an Express/MongoDB backend API.
Integrated the Electron framework to package the administrative web dashboard into a highly performant desktop application.
Implemented automated JSON Schema validation and multi-index aggregation pipelines for fast client-side query performance.
